notes.title: QoL and Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]A laundry list of changes that should make the game more enjoyable![/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where enemies would not be hit around corners if full line of sight was not achieved[/p][/*][*][p]Made a few levels easier by removing enemies that caused frustrating interactions, such as spotting the player and alerting a gunman in areas where little counterplay existed[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly changed the center of the view when aiming to be more towards the player to reduce screen movement[/p][/*][*][p]Caleb's lunge now automatically removes lock-on for easier kick-off aiming[/p][/*][*][p]Rotated the camera in some levels/cutscenes to give a better view[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Aim Overhaul and Boss Changes
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571668/ee07aaceaa8f8e3790a285aff49d121d37fa278a.png"][/img][/p][p]In today's update, For the Greater Good's camera and aiming systems have been completely overhauled. Now, the player aims with a crosshair, and the character will face toward it. You can lock the crosshair onto a specific enemy by pressing the lock-on button (middle click by default). The new system is less disorienting, feels a lot smoother, and requires much less mouse movement in situations that need precise aim. The lock-on function should also make bosses significantly easier since the player can focus on dodging. [/p][p]Aiming on controllers has changed to a twin-stick system with the same lock-on function.[/p][p]The new aiming system will now be the default, and the old third person mode can be selected in the options.[/p][p]A large selection of bosses have been toned down and reworked, especially ones with abilities that needed a large amount of trial and error to figure out. Combined with the new camera system, they should be much less frustrating.[/p][p]Many S rating times have been adjusted since the new aim system seems a little slower to clear levels, but I will look into adjusting more of them if they are unreasonable.[/p]

notes.title: August 5, 2025 Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Fixed a bug preventing bosses from properly absorbing blood at lower framerates[/p][/*][*][p]Increased sound and mouse sens increments in the options menus to 5 and 0.05 respectively[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where skipping the last cutscene through the pause menu would skip the credits[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that made the mouse cursor visible during the credits[/p][/*][/list][p]These changes have also been applied to the demo version of the game.[/p]

notes.title: Release! And future updates
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571668/cc69901f8f3a65b7b04cb6aa878958a6629bcb5c.png"][/img][/p][p]For the Greater Good has officially been released! Fight through 4 acts of intense violence, meet some interesting characters, and experience the story’s twists and turns. And if that’s not enough, there are post-story challenge modes that range from fun to masochistic.[/p][p][/p][p]Some notable changes since the demo came out:[/p][p]A new hint system when fighting bosses (press a button to reveal a hint after death)[/p][p]Enemies with guns can be one-hit killed by any attack[/p][p]The ability to skip any level in the story mode[/p][p]You can now adjust your jump trajectory a bit while in the air[/p][p][/p][p]The demo has also been retroactively updated with these features.
[/p][p]If you find any bugs or have any suggestions, please make a post about it in For the Greater Good’s Steam forums. I’m also open to hearing feedback about the difficulty of specific bosses, etc.[/p][p][/p][p]Short-term future updates:[/p][p]Free, unlockable skins you can earn by completing the post-story challenge modes[/p][p]Adding a missing character’s picture to the main menu[/p][p]Ironing out bugs[/p][p][/p][p]Translating the game:[/p][p]I have made the game files easy to translate, so if the game reaches a moderate level of success, translating the game into various languages will be my top priority.[/p]

notes.title: Release Delay
notes.notes: [p]The game will be released this Friday, July 11th. [/p][p]Sorry and thank you for your patience.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Released
notes.notes:
I’m proud to present the first chapter of For the Greater Good as a free, permanent demo available now. If you enjoy it, wishlisting the game would really help me a lot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571668/5a4275ce9acff2ae96a4994e0af13305f6fa5b35.png[/img]

This demo is also an opportunity to iron out bugs and compatibility issues before the full release. I have made a build of the game for Windows, Mac OS, and Linux, but I have not been able to test compatibility at a larger scale, especially on linux with its wide range of distributions. If you encounter a bug or the game does not run on your operating system, please make a post about it in the game’s steam discussions under the “Bug Reporting” tab, or shoot an email to help.ftgg@gmail.com. Any other feedback is welcome as well.

Thanks for reading and I am looking forward to you guys’ thoughts.
-Alexander Urban
